name: Mihira Bhoja, Gurjara-Pratihara Peak
summary: Under Mihira Bhoja I (reigned 836–885 CE), the Gurjara-Pratihara dynasty reached its greatest extent, ruling an empire stretching across northern India from the Indus to Bengal. The Pratiharas were credited with repelling repeated Arab raids from Sindh, preserving Hindu and Buddhist culture in northern India.
